result.rationale: The official record supports a proposed Keephills data-centre project under a February 2026 MOU, not a formed JV or closed CPP Investments holding. TransAlta is the exclusive site/power provider; CPP Investments and Brookfield are prospective proponents/customers. No separate entity, stake, committed equity, definitive JVA, definitive PPA, land lease, investment close or financial close was verified. AESO grid contracts and queue progress are project milestones, not CPP equity ownership.

identityResolution.boundary: One phased project at TransAlta's Keephills site in Parkland County, Alberta; not a verified manager-level company.

ownershipResolution.roles: CPP Investments and Brookfield are prospective co-proponents/customers/investors; exact Brookfield entity and all stakes are unresolved. TransAlta controls the site position and is the exclusive prospective site and power provider; no project-equity stake was disclosed.
ownershipResolution.bindingStatus: Commercial terms were framed in the MOU, but development remained subject to regulatory approvals and future definitive binding agreements.

operatingResolution.capacity: 230 MW initial phase; potential scale to 1 GW. AESO's August list shows P3083 230 MW active, with P3152 165 MW and P3095 466 MW under review.
operatingResolution.siteAndPower: TransAlta's land position, transmission, gas, water and on-site generation support the concept; no definitive land lease or PPA was verified.
operatingResolution.approvals: County planning/zoning changes permit future proposals but did not approve this project. AESO's 230 MW load contract advances only grid connection.
operatingResolution.endMarkets: Data-centre/digital infrastructure; tenant, operator and offtaker are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
operatingResolution.status: No development-permit application, construction, commissioning or operating load verified.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No later JVA, entity formation, equity funding, definitive PPA/lease, customer commitment, FID, financing close, permit, cancellation, partner change, transfer or exit found through the as-of date.
acquisitionExitCheck.pendingAssessment: Do not add: no equity buyer/seller structure, stake, consideration, committed capital, closing date or close was disclosed.
